output_contract.literals: ASCII numeric tokens: one or more digits optionally followed by a decimal point and zero or more digits, or a decimal point followed by one or more digits; optionally followed by e or E, an optional sign and one or more digits. Signs outside exponent notation are unary operators. Literals will be converted exactly to rationals, never through binary float. NaN, Infinity, underscores, hex and implicit multiplication will be refused.
output_contract.shape: JSON object with expressions mapping exactly sigma_r,sigma_theta,sigma_z,tau_rz,sigma_vm,u_r,u_z to arithmetic strings, and derivation string; expressions will inline helper expressions, with no separately defined symbols
output_contract.brief: The exact syntax/output contract, axis/sign and unit definitions will be included in the hashed physics brief; no comparator formulas or expected values will be supplied.
output_contract.whitespace: ASCII space/tab/CR/LF will be allowed around the response and in expression strings between tokens; each expression CR/LF will become one space before parsing, without joining tokens. Original raw output will remain unchanged. JSON control characters inside strings will require normal JSON escaping.
output_contract.envelope: The entire decoded response will be exactly one bare JSON object, allowing only surrounding ASCII space/tab/CR/LF. UTF8 decoding will be strict; BOM, fences, prose, duplicate keys and extra keys will be refused. Top-level keys will be exactly expressions and derivation; expressions will have exactly the seven specified keys with string values; derivation will be a nonempty string. No wrapper stripping or output repair will occur. Raw bytes will be retained. Noncompliant provider output will leave the gate unestablished; successful conformance is not guaranteed.
output_contract.precedence: Grouping and sqrt(one expression) first, then power, unary signs, multiplication/division, addition/subtraction. Binary +,-,*,/ will associate left. A power exponent will be a signed integer literal, optionally parenthesized: r**-2 and r**(-2) will be equivalent. Chained powers will be refused unless grouped explicitly. -a**2 will mean -(a**2), while (-a)**2 will square the signed base. Noninteger exponents and other function calls will be refused.
output_contract.pre_invocation_tests: B1 tests will cover bare JSON success; fences/prose/extra or duplicate keys/BOM refusal; literal forms including 1e-3; signed exponent equivalence; -a**2 versus (-a)**2; left association of subtraction/division; chained power refusal and explicit grouping; internal escaped newline normalization. Evaluator, envelope, grammar, schema, tests and brief will be frozen before invocation.

numeric_engine: exact rational operations; irrational square root and downstream operations use 50-digit Decimal context
